title: Quality Standard: Initial Health Appointment under the Primary Care Provider Assignment
content:
**Standard.** A member new to Prairie Ridge completes an initial health appointment with the assigned PCP within the practice type's due days of the first assignment's effective date. It is recorded as a visit with the visit type initial health appointment. A telehealth visit satisfies it only where the practice type counts telehealth for the appointment. When the appointment is missed, it is excused only after the counted outreach attempts reach the practice type's required number. Visits and outreach attempts are recorded only on a Primary Care Provider Assignment in active status, as the assignment's status stands on the system record before the visit or attempt is recorded.

**Counted outreach attempts.** Attempts are taken from the assignment's effective date through the handling date, both included. The first attempt always counts; each later attempt counts only when its date is at least the practice type's minimum days apart after the previous counted attempt.

| Practice type | Due within (days of first effective date) | Outreach attempts required | Minimum days between counted attempts | Telehealth counts |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Primary Care Provider | 120 | 3 | 7 | Yes |
| Pediatric Primary Care Provider | 90 | 3 | 7 | No |
| OB/GYN Primary Care Provider | 90 | 3 | 7 | No |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Home | 120 | 3 | 7 | Yes |
| Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice | 90 | 3 | 7 | Yes |
| Specialist Serving as PCP | 120 | 3 | 7 | Yes |
| Health Home Lead Provider | 60 | 4 | 5 | Yes |

**Worked example (hypothetical attempt dates).** Attempts are logged on 3 March, 7 March, 11 March and 22 March.

- With 7 minimum days apart: 3 March counts (first); 7 March does not (4 days after 3 March); 11 March counts (8 days after 3 March); 22 March counts (11 days after 11 March). Three counted attempts: a missed appointment is excused for a Standard Primary Care Provider, where 3 are required.
- With 5 minimum days apart and 4 required (Health Home Lead Provider): 3 March counts; 7 March does not (4 days); 11 March counts (8 days); 22 March counts. Three counted attempts are fewer than 4, so the missed appointment is not excused.

**Telehealth.** An initial health appointment held by telehealth satisfies the standard for a Standard Primary Care Provider and does not for a Pediatric Primary Care Provider.
